title: He caught a big fish. (порядок слов 1)

exercises.instruction: В некоторых предложениях допущена ошибка. Где нужно, исправьте ошибку.

items.prompt: Did you watch all evening TV?
answers: Did you watch TV all evening?

items.prompt: Sue bought some new shoes yesterday.
answers: OK

items.prompt: I like very much this picture.
answers: I like this picture very much.

items.prompt: Tom started last week his new job.
answers: Tom started his new job last week.

items.prompt: I want to speak English fluently.
answers: OK

items.prompt: Jessica bought for her friend a present.
answers: Jessica bought a present for her friend.
Jane bought her friend a present.

items.prompt: I drink every day three cups of coffee.
answers: I drink three cups of coffee every day.

items.prompt: Don’t eat your dinner too quickly!
answers: OK

items.prompt: I borrowed from my brother fifty pounds.
answers: I borrowed fifty pounds from my brother.

exercises.instruction: Составьте предложения, соблюдая правильный порядок слов.

items.prompt: (the door / opened / I / slowly)
answers: I opened the door slowly.

items.prompt: (a new phone / I / last week / got)
answers: I got a new phone last week.

items.prompt: (finished / Paul / quickly / his work)
answers: Paul finished his work quickly.

items.prompt: (Emily / very well / French / doesn’t speak)
answers: Emily doesn’t speak French very well.

items.prompt: (a lot of shopping / did / I / yesterday)
answers: I did a lot of shopping yesterday.

items.prompt: (London / do you know / well?)
answers: Do you know London well?

items.prompt: (we / enjoyed / very much / the party)
answers: We enjoyed the party very much.

items.prompt: (the problem / carefully / I / explained)
answers: I explained the problem carefully.

items.prompt: (we / at the airport / some friends / met)
answers: We met some friends at the airport.

items.prompt: (did you buy / in England / that jacket?)
answers: Did you buy that jacket in England?

items.prompt: (every day / do / the same thing / we)
answers: We do the same thing every day.

items.prompt: (football / don’t like / very much / I)
answers: I don’t like football very much.

exercises.instruction: Составьте предложения, соблюдая правильный порядок слов.

items.prompt: (to work / every day / walks / Lisa)
answers: Lisa walks to work every day.

items.prompt: (at the hotel / I / early / arrived)
answers: I arrived at the hotel early.

items.prompt: (goes / every year / to Italy / Julia)
answers: Julia goes to Italy every year.

items.prompt: (we / since 1998 / here / have lived)
answers: We have lived here since 1998.

items.prompt: (in London / Sue / in 1990 / was born)
answers: Sue was born in London in 1990.

items.prompt: (didn’t go / yesterday / Paul / to work)
answers: Paul didn’t go to work yesterday.

items.prompt: (to a wedding / last weekend / went / Helen)
answers: Helen went to a wedding last weekend.

items.prompt: (I / in bed / this morning / my breakfast / had)
answers: I had my breakfast in bed this morning.

items.prompt: (in September / Amy / to university / is going)
answers: Amy is going to university in September.

items.prompt: (I / a beautiful bird / this morning / in the garden / saw)
answers: I saw a beautiful bird in the garden this morning.

items.prompt: (many times / have been / my parents / to the United States)
answers: My parents have been to the United States many times.

items.prompt: (my umbrella / I / last night / left / in the restaurant)
answers: I left my umbrella in the restaurant last night.

items.prompt: (to the cinema / tomorrow evening / are you going)
answers: Are you going to the cinema tomorrow evening?

items.prompt: (the children / I / took / this morning / to school)
answers: I took the children to school this morning.

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (ходить в спортзал = go to the gym; отвести = take)

items.prompt: Мне очень нравится эта книга.
answers: I like this book very much.
I really like this book.

items.prompt: Роберт ходит в спортзал каждый день.
answers: Robert goes to the gym every day.

items.prompt: Сегодня я обедала в ресторане.
answers: I had lunch in a restaurant today.

items.prompt: Салли десять лет работала в банке.
answers: Sally worked in the bank for ten years.

items.prompt: Ты можешь завтра отвести детей в кино?
answers: Can you take the children to the cinema tomorrow?

items.prompt: Поезд прибыл в Кембридж в семь часов.
answers: The train arrived in Cambridge at seven o’clock.

items.prompt: Я не очень хорошо знаю Марину.
answers: I don’t know Marina very well.

items.prompt: Франк родился в Нью-Йорке в 1994 году.
answers: Frank was born in New York in 1994.
